# bash completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions bash`)
_jet() {
local cur prev cmds flags
COMPREPLY=()
cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
cmds="registry inspect hangar project self diff merge review run jobs check fill test prove status build dev try debug repl notebook import new fmt fix audit lint explain env shared-store cache remote trust image os add remove fetch search find update init split fold gc clean emit eval budget perf report fuzz version help"
flags="--attach --once --observe --raw-frames --dap --gc-trace --structural --base-receipt --receipt --out --repo --json --topic --list-topics --kind --quiet --color --version --check --lang --restore-role-files --diff --simplify --changed --explicit-copies --skipped --stdin-path --small --lib --output --locked --effect --example --lock --read-only --fd -p --annotated --force --no-sign --registry --pkg --clang --ar --from --to --message --before --spdx --cyclonedx --advisory-db --vendor-dir --sbom --verbose --online --fix --dry-run --keep --edition --all --try-anyway --interpret --trace-tiers --restart --swap --watch --canvas --canvas-host --canvas-port --canvas-transport --canvas-authority --canvas-audit --project --protocol --headless --bind --token --pure --freestanding --gate --target --env --preset --explain-partition --update-snapshots --coverage --rust --emit-generated -u --release --profile --set --builder --a11y --complexity --max --scope --filter --shuffle --serial --show-default --measure --record --replay --iterations --time --seed --corpus --lens --facts --annotations --baseline --bootstrap --accept-regression --reason --yes -y --allow-net --deny-net --allow-fs --deny-fs --allow-io --deny-io --allow-db --deny-db --allow-time --deny-time --allow-rand --deny-rand --allow-env --deny-env --allow-exec --deny-exec --allow-log --deny-log --allow-gpu --deny-gpu"
if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 1 ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cmds" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 2 ]]; then
case "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" in
        registry) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "publish yank keygen key vendor" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        inspect) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "live graph query explain-build compiler impact dossier guarantees provenance digest env semindex expand unsafe gates authority schema codemod audit sbom bind logs info outdated reserved facts structure" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        hangar) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "path verify repair copy import export dump restore sign recover rollback generations du" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        project) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "parts" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        self) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "toolchain upgrade doctor completions man devtools lsp exec" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        env) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "test hook sync info" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        shared-store) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "install enroll status broker" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        os) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "push bridge services config" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        gc) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "report" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        perf) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "run test attach view compare export" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        esac
fi
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
}
complete -F _jet jet
